projects.description: Built a Data Lakehouse on Microsoft Fabric to consolidate insurance finance data from PIAS and BRAVO systems, enabling standardized reporting for the investment division.

Standardized and cleansed raw data using PySpark Notebooks and Stored Procedures
Developed Silver-to-Gold ETL workflows to construct a Star Schema, transforming transactional data into optimized Fact and Dimension tables
Managed automated orchestration via Fabric Pipelines, reducing monthly reporting time to under 30 minutes

Engineered ETL pipelines to process complex business logic for P&L, Balance Sheet, and Headcount

Automated the reporting cycle, reducing time by ~90% and ensuring consistency

Wrote advanced SQL logic in Stored Procedures and Views
Optimized SQL queries to boost performance
Handled ad-hoc tasks, developed Tableau solutions, and supported BA communication
